policy.huggingface_hub: Keep current >=2.2.0,<3 policy; do not revive historical <2 blocker text.
policy.optional_core_boundary: Preserve slim core and optional extras; model/native packages are separate lanes.
policy.historical_evidence: Old native and performance results remain tied to their old source and lock hashes.

future_execution: Wait for reviewed RM-34/RM-45 wave checkpoint and a verified clean baseline revision. Reuse that reviewed clean main checkout as baseline; use Codex create_worktree for one isolated candidate worktree from exactly that checkpoint.

Give baseline and candidate separate fresh Python 3.13 environments and separate owned service/database/path fixtures; never mutate main .venv, .venv-rm150, current lock or the currently owned service stack during preparation. Serialize destructive integration cases.

Record baseline tests under the old lock before candidate changes. In candidate run absolute modern uv lock --upgrade for the full graph, inspect direct/transitive additions, removals, downgrades, constraints, yanks and wheel metadata, then update direct minimums based on actual compatible resolution.

Check candidate lock with uv lock --check. Install dev plus no-heavy graph/postgres/mongodb/neo4j/temporal/rest/aws/anyllm/cache/taskiq extras into candidate environment with uv sync --locked; run uv pip check --python on that exact interpreter, import smokes and build-isolated wheel.

Run Ruff, strict mypy, config and golden tests, focused package lanes, then unit/integration/combinations/evals in memory-bounded chunks. Preserve exact pass/skip/xfail/quarantine counts and compare baseline versus candidate under the same code and fixtures.

Run real PostgreSQL global ordering/ledger and cancellation, Mongo transaction/reopen, seven-backend lifecycle, Temporal Activity/reopen/continue-as-new history/shutdown, Ladybug graph/replay/erasure in isolated owned services. Never expose DSNs or credentials in logs.
Run optional SQLCipher, ST/decider/NER and llama-cpp native/toolchain lanes separately. Do not download model weights or claim untested native inference.
For RM-96, use a corrected quiet reference-host protocol, same world/fixture/source and fresh candidate samples; do not relabel historical benchmark records.

Refresh dependency audit only after candidate changes, with --out directed to candidate artifact (audit --check writes its default output). Record exact revision, hashes, interpreter, lock, wheel/install/import, test and residual evidence.

Route any runtime compatibility fix through bounded independent reviews. Require two distinct final reviews of dependency diff, provenance and reproducibility before root decides whether to merge or close PA-113.
